findings.issue: kt4d's 'no mixed separator' conjunct (`not mixed`, where mixed = os.sep != '/' and 'phases/' in said) is vacuously true on any posix run, so on the platforms a developer can run it only the ntpath/posixpath/join equalities and the 'shard_d in said' checks bite; the mixed-separator property itself is decided only by the Windows leg. The executor states this limit; the ntpath equality (nt == 'C:\\plan\\phases\\P1.json') does carry the helper's behaviour on posix, so the helper is covered, the end-to-end message property is not.
findings.resolution: Optional: add an end-to-end arm that forces the decision through the helper's pathmod (e.g. assert the message-building site calls shard_file) or accept the Windows leg as the check; no change needed for release.
